accepted_geometry_comparator: S1A IW relativeorbit105 VV/VH preferred; other tracks/passes/platforms listed as alternatives requiring explicit scientific comparability review, not adopted
support: Frozen90m support/position neighbourhood footprint overlap is metadata feasibility only; actual masks/observability not verified

stop: Return a concrete temporal/source/geometry feasibility decision, including absence of a suitable pair. No automatic processing even if a closer scene exists
